# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Refurbished semi-detached family home on an elevated site in a cul de sac with lovely views at the top of Earlscourt, just off the Dunmore Road. Convenient access to University Hospital Waterford and all local amenities. Accommodation Tiled entrance hall, tiled Guest WC. Living room with laminate wood flooring and gas fireplace, double doors to dining room.
